meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成代码改动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Generate explainer videos from code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR 转成代码讲解视频:读取 diff、提交和文件,生成逐帧分镜、脚本、配音,渲染 mp4,覆盖 changelog、功能展示、修复、重构等类型。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 GitHub PR 的链接、owner/repo#N 这样的引用,或在一个已检出的代码仓库里提到“当前这个 PR”时触发。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#123 做成 changelog 讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 并开始制作流程。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成修复讲解视频
say.note: 针对已检出仓库中的当前 PR 制作。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#456 做一个重构讲解视频
say.note: 按该 PR 的 diff 生成重构讲解。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video: reads the diff, commits, and files; produces storyboard, script, narration; renders mp4, covering changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor types.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a GitHub PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or say 'this PR' in a checked-out repository.

say_en.text: Make owner/repo#123 into a changelog explainer video
say_en.note: Claude ingests that PR and starts production.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a fix explainer
say_en.note: Uses the current PR in the checked-out repo.

say_en.text: Give owner/repo#456 a refactor walkthrough video
say_en.note: Targets that PR and generates the walkthrough.
